gaps.lead: It wasn't necessary for her to bring any food — there was plenty.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it wasn't necessary, but she did it.

gaps.lead: A committee is looking into the sudden rise in food allergies.
gaps.sentence: The sudden rise in food allergies ___ a committee.
gaps.hint: phrasal verb in the progressive passive
gaps.explanation: 'A committee is looking into X' becomes the passive 'X is being looked into by a committee'.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.

gaps.lead: You should check the timetable before travelling.
gaps.sentence: You ___ check the timetable before travelling.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he refuses to read instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he refuses = far too impatient to.
